messages.text: I’ve confirmed bundled AES and ZipCrypto cases. Next I’m implementing native ZIP checks, exact validation messages, and candidate generation order.

commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess,pathlib,json,tempfile,os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); b=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); z=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip').resolve()); d=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt').resolve()); mz=str((root/'rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip').resolve())
cases=[['-i',z,'-w','1','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','1','--maxPasswordLen','2'],['-i',z,'-w','1','-c','l','--minPasswordLen','1','--maxPasswordLen','1'],['-i',z,'-w','1','-p',d],['-i',z,'-w','1','--mask','a?l'],['-i',mz,'-w','1','-p',d],['-i',mz,'-w','1','--fileNumber','99','-p',d]]
for a in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([b,*a],capture_output=True)
 print(json.dumps(a),r.returncode); print('OUT',repr(r.stdout.decode()));print('ERR',repr(r.stderr.decode()))
'@ | python -"
